minor.issue: test_analytics_reflects_new_inward is flaky under pytest-xdist parallel: it fetches today's totals, inserts one 157kg inward, re-fetches and asserts delta≈157. Concurrent inserts in sibling workers inflate the delta past the ±2kg tolerance. Passes 100% in isolation. Not caused by iter11 — same flake present prior. Non-blocking.

When physical_pieces is sent as a plain string value in form-data (e.g. a sample 1x1 PNG blob + '1'), backend returns 500 instead of a 422 — the FastAPI validation error itself fails to JSON-encode because exc.errors() contains the raw photo bytes (UnicodeDecodeError 'utf-8 codec can't decode byte 0x89'). Repro: fetch /api/verifications/{id}/submit with FormData(physical_pieces='1', photo=<1x1 PNG blob>). Expected: 422 with field errors. Observed: 500 Internal Server Error. Likely the pydantic validation serializes a bytes field with ctx values. Does not affect normal UI flows (expo-image-picker upload goes through fine) but worth hardening.

action_items: Optional hardening: in POST /api/verifications/{id}/submit, catch pydantic validation errors on multipart form fields so the 422 handler does not blow up when the photo bytes end up in exc.errors().ctx. Right now bad client input (non-numeric physical_pieces, missing field, etc.) returns 500 instead of 422.

Note (pre-existing, non-blocking): mark test_analytics_reflects_new_inward with @pytest.mark.serial or raise the kg tolerance (±200 kg) so pytest-xdist does not false-fail on same-day concurrent inward inserts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2655 lines — well past the 700 guideline. Split into entries/verifications/catalog/parties/office modules.

GET /parties/ledger aggregation is clean (outward-only, groups by party_name) and the sort key uses a stable timestamp fallback so parties with no last_at don't crash sorting. Shape matches the office portal expectations exactly.

OfficeLayout correctly allows unauth access only on /office/login (early return before auth guard) and redirects labour → /home. OfficeLogin's Redirect on user re-render handles the labour→/home case even if labour successfully auths via that card.

TallyReminder is mounted ABOVE <Stack> in the root layout — effectively a global sticky top banner on every stack screen, auto-hides on /verify via pathname check and when done>=total via comparison. 30s polling + navigation-triggered refetch confirmed.
app/index.tsx redirect: office+web → /office is correct; office on native still goes to /home (expected per spec). No deprecated expo packages. testID coverage excellent on all new office screens.

rca_of_issue: No bugs required a fix this iteration. Two minor observations: (1) /verifications/{id}/submit 500→422 regression — JSON encoder cannot decode photo bytes present in a pydantic error ctx; patch is to swap FastAPI's default validation handler for one that pre-sanitizes exc.errors() with jsonable_encoder on exc.errors() with custom_encoder={bytes: lambda b: f'<{len(b)} bytes>'}. (2) Analytics flake under xdist is a tolerance/scope issue, not a product bug.
